## HAPI v0.26.0.2

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Hotfix on `v0.26.0.1` rebuilt from current `upstream/main` (`27bc6bad`). Adds the React maximum-update-depth fix for session chat (`MessageActions` / upstream [#1380](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/issues/1380), [#1381](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1381)). Retains carries `#1359`, `#986`, `#955`, `#906`, the polluted-schema attachments repair, and the maintained distribution overlay.

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay and carries as `v0.26.0.1`, plus the `#1381` session-chat crash fix so opening a session no longer hits React error #185 from an unstable `useAuiState` object selector in `MessageActions`.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store. PR `#1320` is present because official `upstream/main` already merged it and the operator authorized inheriting that base.
